title: 第11章 除了英俊一无是处的陈长安第12章 斩草必除根
slug: 开局长生不死谁都以为我无敌
lines: 第11章除了英俊一无是处的陈长安？冲击！
来自灵魂的冲击！
陈家这样一个小家族，居然有老祖？
这简直就是一个笑话！天大的笑话！
可如今……人就实实在在的坐在这里，陈正元这样的人，不可能开这种玩笑。
可这……凝元境一重的老祖？
隐藏修为！
对方一定是隐藏了修为！
不错，定是如此，定是如此！
徐家主和宁家主两人对视一眼，不免有些后怕！
“不，这一定不是真的，是陈家人在搞鬼，没错，一定是这样。”
“宁兄，你说对不对？”徐家主此时已经有些乱了心神。
宁家主面露苦涩，他想要反驳，却不知道应该如何反驳，难道真的是陈家人搞鬼吗？
但这种情况的几率，实在是太低太低了！
“陈家主，现在认错，可还有机会？”宁家主表情凝重的看向陈正元。
“抱歉，老祖吩咐，不得不从。”
“动手！”
“我来！”
“我来！”
陈正元一声令下，陈家众人都是蠢蠢欲动，毕竟实力得到提升之后，他们都想要大展身手，好好的发挥一下自己的实力。
然而动作最快的，便是陈家那几位长老，出手毫不留情，不过一个照面，徐家和宁家带来的那些人，便已经损失大半！
看到这一幕，徐家主和宁家主两人是目瞪口呆！
一个月，只有一个月的时间而已，怎么会有如此巨大的变化？
“那是陈正明还有陈正萧？”
“他们两个人的实力……怎么会这么强？”
“好强的实力，他们如今究竟是什么修为？”
“难道是……真气境九重巅峰不成？”
徐家主和宁家主两人的修为，一个真气境三重，一个真气境四重。
放眼整个燕归城，两人实力最强，就算是燕归城附近方圆百里，也没有比他们更强的人存在。
可如今陈家这几位长老，竟然全部达到了真气境九重巅峰？
这样的实力，整个北原郡，又有谁能够抵挡得住？
逃！
两人对视一眼，此时心中只有一个想法，那就是逃跑，尽快逃离陈家！
就在两人这愣神之际，他们所带来的精锐已经尽数被杀。
接下来，就轮到他们两人了！
“住手！”
就在徐家主和宁家主已经死定了的那一刻，突如其来的两个字，让两人心头一震。
content_en:
Chapter 11 Chen Changan, who is nothing but handsome? Impact!
Shock from the soul!
A small family like the Chen family actually has an ancestor?
This is a joke! What a big joke!
But now... people are actually sitting here. It is impossible for people like Chen Zhengyuan to make such a joke.
But this... the ancestor of the first level of the Condensing Yuan Realm?
Hidden cultivation!
The other party must be hiding his cultivation!
Yes, it must be so, it must be so!
The head of the Xu family and the head of the Ning family looked at each other and couldn't help but feel a little scared!
"No, this must not be true. It is the Chen family who is causing trouble. Yes, it must be like this."
"Brother Ning, are you right?" The head of the Xu family was already a little confused at this time.
The head of the Ning family looked bitter. He wanted to refute, but he didn't know how to refute. Could it be that the Chen family was really responsible?
But the probability of this happening is really too low!
"Master Chen, if you admit your mistake now, is there still a chance?" Master Ning looked at Chen Zhengyuan with a solemn expression.
"Sorry, I have to obey my ancestor's orders."
"Do it!"
"I'll do it!"
"I'll do it!"
After Chen Zhengyuan gave the order, everyone in the Chen family was ready to take action. After all, after their strength was improved, they all wanted to show off their skills and give full play to their strength.
However, the fastest movers were the elders of the Chen family, who were merciless in their attacks. However, in just one encounter, most of the people brought by the Xu family and the Ning family had already been lost!
Seeing this scene, the head of the Xu family and the head of the Ning family were stunned!
One month, only one month, how could there be such a huge change?
"Are those Chen Zhengming and Chen Zhengxiao?"
"How come the two of them are so strong?"
"They are so strong. What kind of cultivation are they now?"
"Could it be that... the ninth level of True Qi Realm is at the peak?"
The cultivation levels of the Xu Family Master and the Ning Family Master are that one is at the third level of the True Qi Realm and the other is at the fourth level of the True Qi Realm.
Looking at the entire Yangui City, the two are the strongest. Even within a hundred miles of Yangui City, there is no one stronger than them.
But now these elders of the Chen family have all reached the peak of the ninth level of the True Qi Realm?
Who in the entire Beiyuan County can withstand such strength?
escape!
The two of them looked at each other, and there was only one thought in their minds at this time, and that was to run away and escape from the Chen family as soon as possible!
While the two were stunned, all the elites they brought had been killed.
Next, it's their turn!
"Stop!"
At the moment when the heads of the Xu family and the Ning family were already dead, the sudden words shocked the two of them.
